title: Business Central 2026 release wave 2 (BC29.1): Cross-environment Master Data Management
summary: Business Central 2026 wave 2 introduces cross-environment master data management, allowing organizations to synchronize critical business data like customers, vendors, and products across multiple environments using OAuth authentication within the same tenant. This feature maintains a single source of truth while reducing manual data entry and improving data consistency across development, test, and production environments.
key_points: Synchronize master data across development, test, and production environments to maintain consistency and reduce duplicate maintenance
Requires OAuth authentication with Microsoft Entra app registration restricted to same-tenant connections
Receiving companies can review synchronization logs and define which tables and fields to synchronize with optional filtering
Changes in source company are immediately pulled by the job queue, supporting faster environment setup and smoother application lifecycle management
features: Table and field filtering for synchronization
Immediate data pull via job queue

quotes.text: Keep critical business data consistent across environments with cross-environment master data management.
quotes.why_it_matters: Summarizes the core business value proposition of preventing data inconsistencies across multiple BC instances

quotes.text: synchronization only connects to environments in the same Microsoft Entra tenant.
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies a critical security and architectural constraint that admins must understand when setting up the feature

quotes.text: Changes in the main company are immediately pulled to the receiving companies by the job queue.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the real-time nature of data synchronization, ensuring data remains current across environments
